technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions present potential bounce setup, but severe bearish technicals (price below all MAs, negative MACD, three black crows) and lack of trend confirmation make this a high-risk, low-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, minimal lobbying activity, and no retail interest create a weak fundamental setup with elevated earnings risk in 49 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is stale (228+ days old) with no recent conviction signals, and absent news sentiment limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (413.44), flat yield curve, imminent FOMC event in 2 days, and negative macro score (-5) create severely adverse conditions; earnings in 49 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9), positive squeeze, and supertrend bullish with contrarian fear-zone sentiment create a potential mean-reversion bounce setup from support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages, negative MACD, three black crows pattern, weak ADX trend confirmation, VIX crisis (413.44), imminent FOMC in 2 days, and zero fundamental support make this a high-risk trap with unfavorable macro conditions.
